name: Echoing Violence

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

text:
Frequency once per minute

Trigger You critically succeed with an unarmed Strike against an opponent.

---
Your powerful attack causes damage that reverberates through your opponent's body, shaking muscle from bone. The creature takes 10d6 bludgeoning damage with a basic Fortitude save save against your class DC. If it critically fails, it immediately dies as your blow tears apart its body internally.
